title: Vault: scale-out remove + add a standby (raft rejoin via transit auto-unseal)
description: Two steps. `nexus scale-out remove vault vault-3 --yes` stops vault.service on a standby (it remains a raft peer); `nexus scale-out add vault --role standby --yes` restarts it, auto-unseals via vault-transit, and rejoins the raft quorum in ~3.6s.

observe.what: vault.service stopped on vault-3 (a standby); it remains a registered raft peer; cluster stays green on the other two voters
vault-3 restarted, auto-unseals via vault-transit, rejoins raft as a standby voter in ~3.6s; quorum back to 3

whatProves: VaultAdapter scale-out remove stops a standby's vault.service while leaving it a raft peer, and scale-out add restarts it so it auto-unseals through vault-transit and rejoins the raft quorum (~3.6s) - a non-destructive standby cycle.
